notes.title: Tutorial, thumb sticks, volume, bug fixes.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] A tutorial level has been added at the start of the game.
[*] Game controller's thumb sticks can now be used for movement.
[*] A volume option is now available on the settings menu.
[*] A few small bugs are fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Huge update!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] 43 additional levels in the form of Story D.
[*] New unlockable accessories to dress Loaf up in.
[*] Bug fixes and performance improvements.
[/list]
